components.name: Appfunctions
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Add @AppFunctionAccessLevel annotation to support access restriction setting. (Id47e1)
  • Rename AppFunction annotation to AppFunctionDeclaration (I4b15d)
  • Rename ObserveAppFunctionsEvent to AppFunctionsChangeEvent (Iec918)
  • Surface AppFunctionMetadata in AppFunctionService. (If1117)

Bug Fixes

  • Support all built-in proxy types (LocalDate, LocalTime, Instant, ZoneId) in AppFunctionData. (I61c16)

components.name: Benchmark
components.detailsHtml:
New Features

  • The benchmark :lockClocks task now uses fixed performance mode when available, over the previous root-only implementation. This means you can lock clocks on many more physical devices for stable results, especially for useful for stable microbenchmarks. Please report issues with thermal throttling with the new behavior if you see it. (I0d032)

API Changes

  • Added MemoryProfilingConfig to ExperimentalConfig to allow macrobenchmark runs to opt into Perfetto heap profiling. (Ibc931)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a bug in microbenchmark where method trace capture was sometimes overcautiously skipped to avoid ANRs. (Ifc307)
  • Fix Baseline profile capture for processes not using a :<suffix> naming pattern. (I512ab)
  • Profiler trace links are now reported under a separate 'Profiling Traces' section in IDE summaries. (Id639f)
  • Fix a bug in virtual file flushing which would result in Unable to flush profiles for <packagename>. (I48ccc)
  • Fix synchronization in method traces embedded in system trace. Ifd2e33 b/537688349
  • Baseline Profile Gradle Plugin - Improved CollectBaselineProfileTask to support finding test-result.pb files in subdirectories, enabling compatibility with the new built-in test platform. Id9c488 b/543799367

components.name: Car App
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Tab Global End Action: Added support for a global end action to TabTemplate via setEndAction and getEndAction, along with ActionsConstraints.ACTIONS_CONSTRAINTS_TAB_ACTIONS. (I5c203)
  • Section Header Enhancements: Added setHeadline to SectionHeader.Builder (headline and subtitle are mutually exclusive), and relaxed icon constraints in SectionHeader.Builder.setStartIcon() and setEndIcon() to allow TYPE_URI (content://) icons. (I55e08, I97243)
  • Progress Bar Track Color: Added trackColor to CarProgressBarStyle to customize the unfilled portion of a progress bar. (I1c819)
  • Custom Tinted CarIcon: Added CarIcon.createTintedIcon(IconCompat, CarColor) to create a tinted icon with a custom tint color. (Icb804)

Bug Fixes

  • Clarified documentation on CarProgressBar.Builder.setStyle() and CarIcon.Builder.setStyle(), and updated bouncycastle dependency in :car:app:app-testing. (I2cdb3, Ie02d5)

components.name: Collection
components.detailsHtml:
Important changes since 1.6.0:

  • Added .toOrderedScatterSet() extension. This provides a read-only alternative to the mutable conversion function and returns an allocation-free singleton when the source collection is empty.
  • Implemented toString() for ScatterMap.asMap key, value, and entry views. This provides better debug visibility for developers using the asMap() wrapper.
  • Optimized ScatterMap.getOrPut() performance.
  • Added sortWith, sortBy, and sortByDescending functions to MutableObjectList, alongside binarySearch algorithms on ObjectList and primitive list classes (FloatList, IntList, LongList, DoubleList). Added binarySearch overloads using exact component types for FloatList, LongList, and DoubleList alongside existing Int methods.
  • Improved hashing in ScatterMap and primitive collections to reduce collisions for Float keys.

components.name: Compose Animation
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a crash in SeekableTransitionState where rounding NaN values threw an IllegalArgumentException during zero-duration or interrupted transitions. (I8f3a9, b/555294641)

components.name: Compose Foundation
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added @FloatRange and @IntRange annotations to PolygonShape and PolygonShapeScope factory parameters, and restricted innerRadiusRatio in PolygonShape.star and PolygonShape.pillStar to (0f, 1f). (I47ea3)
  • Updated PolygonShape APIs: moved CornerRounding to top-level with dp() and fraction() factories, replaced transformed() and scaledToFit() extensions with in-place mutable PolygonShape.transform(PolygonShapeTransformScope.() -> Unit) and PolygonShape.copy(). (If5970)
  • Fixed a bug where requesting focus on a BasicTextField before the window was focused (e.g. in onCreate) caused the software keyboard to not appear. BasicTextField now waits for the window to gain focus before starting the text input session. If this causes problems for developers, you can revert to the previous behavior by setting ComposeFoundationFlags.isTextFieldWaitWindowFocusForInputSessionEnabled to false. (I4206b)
  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)
  • Added a styleLayer() method to CommonStyle that declares that all properties is in a layer will take precedence over properties set in a lower layer. The state() method (and state helpers like pressed()) now implicitly create a layer. (I24473)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue in FlexBox where setting alignContent(FlexAlignContent.Stretch) incorrectly forced child items to stretch with line. (Ida156)
  • Fixed an issue in FlexBox where a single wrapped line (FlexWrap.Wrap or FlexWrap.WrapReverse) was forcibly expanded to the container's minimum cross-axis constraint, causing alignContent and alignItems to misalign items. (I038b1)
  • Fixed an IllegalStateException crash when updating consumeWindowInsets, windowInsetsPadding, or onConsumedWindowInsetsChanged on detached modifier nodes, such as during movableContent movement. (I80ae5)
  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)

components.name: Compose Material
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)

components.name: Compose Material3
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Restored TopAppBarDefaults.enterAlwaysScrollBehavior overload taking reverseLayout as deprecated with warning to maintain compatibility with 1.4. (I4a87a)
  • Restored DraggableState on SliderState and retained Slider, VerticalSlider, and RangeSlider overloads with nullable onValueChange as hidden deprecated APIs to maintain binary compatibility. (Ie4aee)
  • Updated PolygonShape APIs: moved CornerRounding to top-level with dp() and fraction() factories, replaced transformed() and scaledToFit() extensions with in-place mutable PolygonShape.transform(PolygonShapeTransformScope.() -> Unit) and PolygonShape.copy(). (If5970)
  • HorizontalCenteredHeroCarousel's maxItemWidth parameter has been renamed to preferredItemWidth. (Ie7883)
  • Added CarouselDefaults.ItemSpacing and CarouselDefaults.ContentPadding, which hold the default item spacing and content padding used by the carousel composables. (I2f36a)

components.name: Compose Material3 Adaptive
components.detailsHtml:
Dependencies

  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)

components.name: Compose Remote
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added createThemedRemoteColor to RemoteColor.Companion for light/dark theme-aware remote colors. (I0214b)
  • Introduced RemoteTextMeasurer and rememberRemoteTextMeasurer to measure text dimensions in RemoteCompose. (Icb4f1)
  • Added Float.rsp and RemoteFloat.rsp extension properties to create Sp RemoteTextUnit instances from float literals and dynamic RemoteFloat expressions. (I21403)
  • Exposed state creation constructors and factory functions annotated with @RememberInComposition. (I6db3d)
  • Added an optional profile parameter to RemoteDocumentPreview to configure the document buffer before inflation. (I58900)
  • Added support for DrawTextOnCircle in RemoteCompose player and test profiles. (I859cb)

Bug Fixes

  • Remote Compose players now load DEFLATE-compressed documents (Icb094)
  • Hardened captureSingleRemoteDocument and captureRemoteDocument lifecycle and snapshot handling across background and main dispatchers, and fixed captureRemoteDocument silently dropping updates when the collector could not keep up with recomposition. (I28565)
  • Added support for custom enter/exit visibility animations. (I7857a)
  • Updated RemoteTimeDefaults.defaultTimeString to format 12-hour time as h:mm without AM/PM, matching Wear Compose Material 3 TimeTextDefaults. (I6a05e)
  • Fix spring-backed float animations snapping to their target instead of animating after an idle period. (Id026a)
  • Fix spring animations producing out-of-range values on slow or dropped frames. (I9cf09)
  • Avoid emitting duplicate WidthModifier/HeightModifier operations when multiple dimension modifiers are chained on a component. (I32a62)

components.name: Compose Runtime
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a bug where passing Float.NaN or Double.NaN into a @Composable function would prevent that function from ever skipping recomposition, even when all arguments are unchanged. This bug affected functions that received Dp.Unspecified because Dp.Unspecified is backed by Float.NaN. (I7a643, b/564569402)
  • The CompositionObserver is now resolved once per composition pass. Setting or replacing it with setObserver while a composition is in progress takes effect starting with the next pass. Movable content insertion now also reports onBeginComposition and onEndComposition. (Iad280)
  • The calculation block of computedStateOf is now enforced to be read-only. Writing to a state inside this block will throw an IllegalStateException. (Id045f, b/456249371)
  • Fixed a memory leak in LinkComposer where moving movableContent retained wrapper group slots across moves. (I17af2)
  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Support off-main thread usage of ComposeTracer. (I139e4)

External Contribution

  • Fixed an issue in computedStateOf that could lead to unexpected invalidations when read with SnapshotStateObserver. (Ie3f8b, b/561372470)

components.name: Compose Ui
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Reverted Modifier.interactionBarrier() from the public API surface for 1.13. (I47974, b/564575045, b/347038246)
  • Updated PolygonShape APIs: moved CornerRounding to top-level with dp() and fraction() factories, replaced transformed() and scaledToFit() extensions with in-place mutable PolygonShape.transform(PolygonShapeTransformScope.() -> Unit) and PolygonShape.copy(). (If5970)
  • onValueChange is now a required parameter on Slider, VerticalSlider, and RangeSlider. Removed previously hidden deprecated APIs across Slider and RangeSlider components, including the DraggableState implementation on SliderState and legacy Saver overloads. Removed isVertical from SliderState. Deprecated SliderDefaults.Thumb overload taking SliderState in favor of the isVertical overload. (I3fdc1)
  • The Posture class in MediaQuery has been replaced with WindowPosture, which exposes physical WindowFolds (FoldState and FoldOrientation). Added isTabletop and isFlat convenience properties on WindowPosture, and removed the explicit Book posture. (Id9e8e)
  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)
  • Added @FloatRange to BlurStop.fraction, changed the default fallOffRadius in BlurRadiusSpec.radialGradient to Dp.Unspecified, renamed Modifier.blur's radius parameter to blurRadiusSpec, and renamed BlurScope.radius to blurRadiusSpec. (I91dbc, b/556335791)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an IllegalArgumentException ('LayoutNode not found in RectList') when alignment lines are queried during measurement. (Icec9e, b/549552303)
  • VectorPainter will now share internal graphics resources (ImageBitmap) when rendering the same ImageVector across multiple composables. This reduces redundant texture uploads and memory usage, improving performance in scenarios like lists using repeated icons. This optimization can be disabled via ComposeUiFlags.isVectorDrawCacheSharingEnabled. (I91b41)
  • Fixed a bug where AndroidTextPaint.setTextMotion did not clear LINEAR_TEXT_FLAG when transitioning to FontHinting or None linearity. (I8c19c)
  • Fixed an issue where TalkBack touch exploration focus could jump to an embedded AndroidView (such as a WebView) covered by Compose UI content. (I11372, b/561099702)
  • Fixed an issue where calling Color.toColorLong() or setting a color composited over Color.Unspecified on a Paint could crash with an IllegalArgumentException. (Ia365b, b/557521315)
  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Fixed parameter extraction in tooling for composables with >10 parameters. (Ib167d)
  • Fixed an issue where deactivated layout nodes were not cleared from the layout queue, causing a crash during remeasure. (Ie64a5)

components.name: Core
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Bump core-telecom to 1.1.0-rc01. (Iba053)
  • Fixed an issue where video calls started with a preferred audio endpoint (such as the phone earpiece) would erroneously revert to the device speaker shortly after connecting. (I38ea6)
  • Fixed an issue where video calls would incorrectly route audio to the device speaker instead of a connected wired headset on call start. (I575a8)
  • Allow VoIP apps to disconnect with DisconnectCause.ERROR starting in SDK 38, with automatic remapping to LOCAL on older platform versions. (I5a58c)

components.name: Core Uwb
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Bug fixes for the sensor fusion feature and minor documentation improvements. (Ic3ce5, b/563444625)

components.name: Glance Wear
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added CATEGORY_PROVIDER_CONFIG, EXTRA_CONFIG_WIDGET_ID, and EXTRA_CONFIG_PROVIDER_COMPONENT constants to GlanceWearWidget for handling widget provider configuration intents. (I32fa4)
  • Renamed useSafeFallbackRendererVersion parameter in the WearWidgetPreview to useBaselineHostVersion. (I07bca)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed widget updates in the Widget Tray Emulator when calling triggerUpdateAll on debuggable builds. (I22d3f)
  • Changed the default value of useSafeFallbackRendererVersion in WearWidgetPreview from true to false so previews render with the latest renderer version by default. (Ied6b9)

components.name: Graphics
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added CanvasFrontBufferRenderer#execute API (Ie82c8)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a race condition during GLFrameBufferRenderer teardown by releasing SurfaceControl on the GL thread.
  • Fixed inverted buffer transforms in CanvasFrontBufferedRenderer and LowLatencyCanvasView.
  • Added fallback display rotation resolution for API < 32 devices.
  • Fixed visual artifacts on devices that do not preserve buffer contents.
  • Fixed redundant draws and render stalls when surfaces are recreated.
  • Fixed memory leaks by unparenting SurfaceControl instances and clearing references on release().
  • Reduced allocations and redundant thread hops during draw loops.
  • Replaced unused annotation-experimental dependency with annotation:1.8.0.

components.name: Navigation3
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • SceneInfo class has added title and url properties which are automatically populated from the Scene's last NavEntry's metadata. Use TitleMetadataKey and UrlMetadataKey to define destination titles and URLs in the entry's metadata.. (I78a20, b/542693522)

components.name: Navigationevent
components.detailsHtml:
Important changes since 1.1.0:

New in TestNavigationEventDispatcherOwner

  • Added onForwardCompletedFallback to enable tracking and testing of unhandled forward navigation events.
  • Added navigationEventInput to simplify simulating navigation events in tests

New in NavigationEventInput

  • Added hasEnabledHandlers, hasEnabledBackHandlers, and hasEnabledForwardHandlers to allow developers to query the current handler state directly without relying on callbacks.

Other changes

  • New NavigationEventDispatcherOwner factory to allow easy creation of a owner backed by the given NavigationEventDispatcher
  • Title and url properties added to NavigationEventInfo to allow customizing the destination title and location URL.

components.name: Paging
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Pager.append() calls before initial refresh completes will no longer throw NoSuchElementException. The append call will be no-op. (Ide387, b/556780796)

components.name: Test Backup
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Payload keys are now documented as BackupActionInputKeys, BackupActionOutputKeys, and BackupActionValues, replacing the constants on BackupDeviceAction. Added BackupDeviceActionResult.success() and failure() factories, along with isSuccess and errorMessage accessors. (Ibd493)

Bug Fixes

  • BackupRestoreController.clearAppData now throws IOException when pm clear does not report success, instead of continuing silently. (I61556)
  • Shell arguments passed to BackupRestoreController for device execution are now correctly escaped to prevent command injection and ensure file paths with spaces are handled securely.
  • Hardened the bundled storage actions (PopulateStorageAction and AssertStorageAction) against silent verification passes to ensure tests strictly fail when expected data is missing.
  • Host-side test orchestrators now correctly honor in-band action failures reported by the device instead of ignoring them.
  • Fixed an issue with database row population by percent-encoding the database 'values' wire format, preventing data corruption during payload transport.
  • Addressed security vulnerabilities in androidx.test.backup:backup-host by upgrading dependencies.

components.name: Wear Compose
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fix OneHandedGestureHintScrollIndicator animation flicker (I650c6)
  • Remove scroll lock from OneHandedGestureScrollIndicator and manage indicator visibility in ScreenScaffold with a composition local (I13050)
  • Fix IllegalStateException in Modifier.oneHandedGesture (I35151)

components.name: Wear Compose
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added new AppScaffold and ScreenScaffold overloads without the timeText parameter, establishing the recommended direction for Wear Compose 1.8 to migrate to the new System Status Bar. When running on older builds without System Status Bar, these new overloads fall back to default TimeText. The existing overloads now migrate to the System Status Bar by default unless an explicit custom timeText is provided. (I40a5e)
  • Added StatusBarSuppression helper composable to suppress the System Status Bar within full-screen and overlay components. (I387c3)
  • Introduced Modifier.curveToEdge, which uses a shader to curve a component to the border of the parent container around the center, always treating the container as a circle. Known issues: clickable components will have incorrect clickable bounds and TalkBack does not highlight components correctly. (I8bbaa)
  • Added PullToRefreshBox and PullToRefreshState to Wear Compose Material 3, with drag distances and refresh thresholds tailored for Wear OS devices.(Iee9a5)
  • Promoted PullToRefreshBox, PullToRefreshDefaults, and PullToRefreshState to stable public APIs in Wear Compose Material 3. (I079b6)
  • Adds an overload of SwipeToReveal with a transformation parameter to support container transformations in TransformingLazyColumn. (I328ce)
  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)
  • Removed experimental feature flag WearComposeFoundationFlags.isTransformingLazyColumnClickableThresholdEnabled. The clickable threshold in TransformingLazyColumn is now always enabled. (Ib68c8)
  • Removed experimental flag WearComposeFoundationFlags.isTransformingLazyColumnPinnableContainerEnabled. (Ibad2e)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed bug in Wear Compose Foundation HorizontalPager, where the gesture handling failed to prioritize correctly between paging and swiping to dismiss. (I54caf)
  • Added Modifier.testTag("time_text") to TimeText so that it can be detected in test cases where System Status Bar falls back to a default TimeText composable. (Iacb09)
  • Fixed IllegalStateException in OneHandedGestureModifier.updateCompositionLocals caused by accessing nodes before attachment. (I662271)
  • Added AlertDialog gesture support, so that scrolling down and Confirm button clicks are available by default. (I51f81)
  • Fixed in-app TimeText flash when transitioning to inherited status bar by improving visibility suppression logic in ScreenContent. (I12dd01)
  • Fixed an issue where components suppressing the System Status Bar (such as Stepper) fell back to rendering an in-app TimeText. (I86830)
  • Fixed StatusBarSuppression() to respect LocalStatusBarEnabled when the global status bar is disabled, preventing unnecessary layout passes in dialogs. (I4f77f6)
  • Fixed an issue in Wear Material3 Scaffold where currentScrollInfoProvider did not inherit from underlying screens when the top screen provided null. (I97874)
  • Added support for Dialog status bar suppression and nested ScreenScaffolds in Wear Material3 Scaffold. (I01772)
  • Fixed an issue in AppScaffold where the status bar overlay reappeared while scrolling when the top anchor item. (I421b3)
  • Fixed an issue where ScreenScaffold top padding collapsed when opening screens with a disabled status bar mode. (I7cf4f)
  • Added multi-window status bar orchestration support to Wear Compose Material3 scaffolds, allowing dialogs and separate windows to drive their own system status bar controllers. (Ibf82c)
  • Made TransformingLazyColumn robust to negative item spacings (I99ac7)
  • Optimized gesture indicators by replacing indicator pointer background in the resources with canvas functions using paths. (Iee2b7)
  • Optimized gesture indicators by replacing primary and dismiss AVDs in the resources with draw functions using paths. (Ib2d05)
  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Updated baseline profiles for Wear Compose Foundation, Material3, and Navigation3 libraries. (I9b0a3)

components.name: Wear Compose Remote
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Add RemoteButtonDefaults.buttonWithContainerPainterColors overload supporting color customization. (If62d4)
  • Introduce RemoteBorderStroke and add border: RemoteBorderStroke? parameter to RemoteCard, RemoteAppCard, and RemoteTitleCard. Add RemoteCardDefaults.outlinedCardBorder. (I57abf)
  • Added backgroundColor and container background arc rendering to RemoteHorizontalPageIndicator and RemoteVerticalPageIndicator to match Material 3 specifications. (Ifd062)
  • Add childButtonColors to RemoteButtonDefaults, and add unbounded RemoteButtonDefaults.scrimBrush. (Iadcf2)

Bug Fixes

  • Animate RemoteSwitchButton and RemoteSplitSwitchButton in Wear Remote Compose Material 3 (I1b4a2)
  • Animate RemoteRadioButton and RemoteSplitRadioButton in Wear Remote Compose Material 3 (Ifc655)
  • Animate RemoteCheckboxButton and RemoteSplitCheckboxButton in Wear Remote Compose Material 3 (Icf89c)

components.name: Webkit
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Clarified in documentation that Profile custom request header changes take effect on document load. (Id3b6f, b/561650101)

components.name: Xr Arcore
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where OpenXrRuntime failed to configure the session when augmented image tracking was unsupported. (I8b9759)
  • Fixed multiple issues including: improved memory management in XrInstanceManager by using applicationContext, resolved potential lifecycle-related issues by simplifying Session and Scene caching mechanisms, and enhanced the ReferenceCleaner to ensure thread-safe cleanup registrations and explicit disposals. (Id0b76c)

components.name: Xr Glimmer
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Add focused color customization to Button (I6524a)

components.name: Xr Runtime
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed various issues in androidx.xr.runtime and androidx.xr.scenecore to improve memory safety and resource lifecycle management. This includes updates to context handling and reference cleanup logic to prevent memory leaks. (Id61f8)

components.name: Xr Scenecore
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a potential memory leak by removing the perceptionRuntimeCache in SessionExt and refactored it to retrieve the PerceptionRuntime directly from the Session instance. (Ie35b1)
  • Fixed a potential context leak by using applicationContext for OpenXR native handles to ensure the native runtime does not hold references to an Activity context. (Ie35b1)
  • Fixed race conditions in XrInstanceManager by introducing proper synchronization and initialization locking. (Ie35b1)
  • Fixed ReferenceCleaner to support de-registration of cleaning actions and ensured Entity cleanup actions are run explicitly during dispose(), preventing duplicate execution upon garbage collection. (Ie35b1)
  • Fixed a memory leak in Scene by removing the sceneCache in SessionExt and refactoring Scene to fetch the instance directly from sessionConnectors. (Ie35b1)
